key.name: location
key.description: "panel": a top-bar button with a menu and the history; "quick-settings": a round button beside quick settings' screenshot button, with results as notifications.

key.name: microphone
key.description: Record the default microphone instead of the sound the computer is playing.

key.name: listen-seconds
key.description: How many seconds are recorded for each recognition.

key.name: click-action
key.description: "open" opens its Shazam page; "copy" copies its title and artist.

key.name: notify
key.description: Show the result in a notification when the menu was closed while listening.

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many recognized songs the history keeps.

key.name: history
key.description: Recognized songs, newest first: key, title, artist, cover, url and time (Unix seconds).
